title: N-ary Tree Postorder Traversal
goal: Visit every child subtree before its parent in left-to-right order.
strategy: A stack entry records whether its children have already been scheduled. First defer the parent beneath its reversed children; when the deferred parent returns to the top, all child subtrees are complete.
